volunteerExperiences.description: Working for two North American missionaries as translator and also doing some construction work is one of my most cherished experiences. Helping Honduran ethnic groups such as the Tolupan people and poor people in the rural areas close to La Flor mountains have taught me to be thankful for everything God has given to me.

A short mission trip to impoverish areas in South Thailand where we share many activities with the locals, encouraging the young people to stay away from drugs, we share some goods with people in the slums and hold camps for kids and teenagers.

projects.title: Anxiety and Panic Attacks Detector
projects.description: The system comprises three sensors connected to the Arduino Yun, namely, the Galvanic Skin Response, Ear-clip Heart rate and the EMG sensors that received the information which is gathered by the Arduino Yun and sent via hypertext transfer protocol (HTTP) to a RESTful server located in the Acer aBeing sensor hub. The server (in aBeing) analyzes the data and detects the person emotional state. If the person is nervous to the point of having an anxiety attack (or panic attack) aBeing notifies the person in charge via an App.
